paragraphs: PTSB is a bank in Ireland. It is the third-biggest Irish bank. A bank from Austria called Bawag wants to buy all of it.
Now the European Central Bank says yes to the sale. Bawag says this is an important step. It has wanted PTSB for months.
Bawag will pay €1.6 billion. That is €2.97 for each share. The Irish Government owns 57.5% of PTSB.
A court in Dublin must also say yes. It will decide next week. This is the last step. A few small owners of shares do not want the sale. Another company wanted more time to make a different offer.

paragraphs: The European Central Bank (ECB) has given its approval for the Austrian bank Bawag to buy PTSB. PTSB is the third-largest Irish bank.

The deal is worth €1.6 billion, or €2.97 for each share. Bawag said the ECB decision was an important step towards completing the sale. The Minister for Finance owns 57.5 per cent of PTSB, so the State is the biggest shareholder.
However, the deal still needs approval from the High Court. The court held a hearing last week and is expected to give its decision next week. This will be the final step.

At the hearing, a small group of shareholders said they were against the deal. One of them said the minister had special information that other shareholders did not have. A company called Axis Capital asked for up to six weeks to prepare a different offer, but the minister's lawyer said it was not close to being ready.

PTSB是愛爾蘭第三大銀行。

Bawag說歐洲央行的決定是完成這筆交易的重要一步。
財政部長擁有PTSB的57.5%，所以國家是最大股東。
不過，這筆交易仍需要高等法院批准。
法院上週舉行了聽審，預計下週做出決定。
這將是最後一步。
在聽審中，一小群股東表示反對這筆交易。
其中一人說部長掌握了其他股東沒有的特殊資訊。
一家名叫Axis Capital的公司要求最多六週時間來準備另一份出價，但部長的律師說它離準備好還差得遠。

paragraphs: The European Central Bank has granted regulatory approval for the Austrian lender Bawag to acquire PTSB, Ireland's third-largest domestic bank.

The takeover values PTSB at €1.6 billion, or €2.97 per share. Bawag described the ECB's decision as an important milestone on the way to completing the deal. The Minister for Finance is the bank's largest shareholder, with a 57.5 per cent stake.

The bid still requires the approval of the High Court, which heard arguments from both banks, the minister and a group of minority shareholders last week. A ruling is expected next week and would be the final hurdle in Bawag's months-long effort to buy the bank.

During the hearing, three small shareholders who oppose the offer argued that the minister had enjoyed access to information that other investors did not receive. Meanwhile, the advisory firm Axis Capital sought a delay of up to six weeks to prepare a rival bid.
Lawyers for the minister rejected that request, saying Axis was nowhere near ready to make an offer.

這次收購對PTSB的估值為16億歐元，即每股2.97歐元。
Bawag形容歐洲央行的決定是完成交易途中的重要里程碑。
財政部長是該銀行最大的股東，持股57.5%。

預計下週做出裁決，這將是Bawag長達數月收購行動的最後一道關卡。
聽審期間，三名反對這項出價的小股東主張，部長取得了其他投資人未獲得的資訊。
與此同時，顧問公司Axis Capital要求延後最多六週，以準備一份競爭性出價。
部長的律師拒絕了這項請求，說Axis根本還沒準備好提出出價。

paragraphs: The European Central Bank has given its regulatory blessing to the Austrian lender Bawag's proposed acquisition of PTSB, the third-largest domestic bank in Ireland.

The transaction values PTSB at €1.6 billion, equivalent to €2.97 per share. Bawag hailed the decision as a pivotal milestone, while the Minister for Finance retains a commanding 57.5 per cent stake in the bank.

The deal must still clear one final hurdle: sanction from the High Court, which heard submissions last week from both banks, the minister and a cluster of minority shareholders. Its ruling is anticipated next week.

At the hearing, a trio of dissenting shareholders, collectively holding a minuscule fraction of the bank, contended that the minister had been privy to information withheld from other investors. The advisory firm Axis Capital, for its part, sought an adjournment of up to six weeks to assemble a rival bid.
Counsel for the minister dismissed that request out of hand, insisting that Axis was nowhere near in a position to table a credible offer.
